preconditions.description: The number of towns is between 1 and 10^5.
The number of roads is between 0 and 10^5.
The number of different types of goods necessary to hold a fair is between 1 and the minimum of n and 100.
Each town produces one type of goods which is between 1 and k.
Towns are numbered from 1 to n and there are no more than one road between every two towns.

preconditions.expression: You can go from any town to any other town via roads

postconditions.expression: Output is a list of n numbers
postconditions.description: The output must be a list of integers where the i-th number represents the minimum number of coins needed to spend on travel expenses to hold a fair in town i.
